description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic and The Lunar Whale as attackers. When Cheering Fanatic triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: The Lunar Whale
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent
